blocks.text: SEOUL – Dating rumors about Blackpink member Lisa and Thai actor Blue Pongtiwat have swept social media after the two were reportedly spotted together in Bangkok. Photos circulating online showed Lisa and Pongtiwat walking along Song Wat Road in Bangkok on Monday. The sighting also came days after the pair were reportedly seen dining together at a restaurant in Bangkok with Lisa’s family members on Oct. 15, further fueling speculation that their relationship may extend beyond friendship.
